mechanism: Metoprolol inhibits CYP2D6 metabolism of haloperidol, increasing haloperidol plasma concentrations and risk of antipsychotic toxicity; both drugs prolong QT interval and have negative inotropic effects.
action: Monitor cardiac function (ECG baseline and periodic), watch for extrapyramidal symptoms and haloperidol toxicity; consider alternative beta-blocker or antipsychotic; dose reduction of haloperidol may be necessary.
